jumps.reason: Q1 FY2027 net sales fell and missed estimates on a tequila slowdown (Reuters, WSJ 2026-09-02, fact sheet News & sentiment); note's bear case: 'Sales keep declining and ROIC keeps eroding' -- a further quarterly miss is the recurring discrete trigger for an acute repricing, distinct from the gradual multiple-compression already built into the bear scenario target.
